name: Navy Body Composition Assessment, Step 1 (waist-to-height ratio)

source.document: Navy Physical Fitness Assessment Guide-4, Body Composition Assessment

ifOver: Step 2 is required: the Navy estimates body fat from the height-waist difference and weight. The maximum is 26% for men and 36% for women; over that fails the physical assessment for the cycle unless an exemption applies.
notes: The ratio is rounded down to four decimals; 0.5499 or less is within standards, 0.5500 or more needs Step 2.
The Navy rounds height up to the nearest half inch and weight to the nearest pound before the calculation.
